text:
alex: Hi folks, I'm onboarding to on-call and would like to shadow a weekday shift. What's the process to sign up and what should I prepare?

sam: Welcome @alex! We pair new shadowers with a primary + secondary for a full 8h window. Quick rules: primary answers pages, secondary covers breaks/followups, shadower observes and runs read-only checklist. No production writes without explicit mentor OK.

maya: Preferred learning slots are Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 local UTC. If you want a stressed window, try Tue morning when deployments often land. Pre-reads: runbook -> "Triaging Alerts", dashboards -> latency & queue-depth.

alex: I can do Tue 09-17. Who do I ping to be added? Any short checklist I can run locally?

jordan: Ping @sam to add you. Practice these safe commands (read-only) beforehand:
```bash
# recent errors
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/query?m=errors%5B1h%5D" | jq .

# list active serving pools
rdwctl pools list --env prod

# get autoscaler events (read-only)
rdwctl autoscaler history --pool inference-prod --limit 50
```
Also practice annotating incidents in Slack: short, link to dashboards, and an "impact:" line.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: P2 queue-backlog spike on model-pool-A (routed to primary @samantha)

samantha: Acked. Starting triage. @alex you can watch and take notes. First checks: any recent deploys? check deploy log; is backlog growing on a single route; are worker pods restarting?

samantha: I'll narrate steps so shadower sees decision points. 1) Confirm scope (routes/customers) 2) Check rolling restarts 3) Evaluate mitigation (scale, route-circuit)

alex: If I see a possible mitigation, should I suggest it?

samantha: Yes, speak up. Keep suggestions as proposals: e.g., "suggest scaling pool +2 for 10m to test impact". Only primary executes changes.

maya: For queue/backlog pages, useful quick checks: `rdwctl queue status --pool model-pool-A` and `rdwctl trace top --last 10m --latency 95`. Look for sudden client-side spikes or model cold-starts.

alex: Got it. What's the formal handoff at the end of the shadow shift?

sam: Handoff template to post in the rotation doc and Slack thread: - shift: 09:00-17:00 UTC - primary: @samantha - secondary: @maya - shadower: @alex - active incidents: (URLs + 1-line impact) - outstanding actions: list (who/what/due) - next oncall contact: mention handle

sam: We also send a single-line summary to #oncall-rotations e.g. `09:00-17:00 | p=samantha | s=maya | shadow=alex | incidents=1`

jordan: Some escalation rules to remember: P1 >20m escalate to Eng Director oncall, customer-facing error rate >8% for 10m -> page Support Lead. We have playbooks linked in the runbook.

alex: If I'm shadowing and miss a page because I'm away, what's expected?

maya: Primary owns it. After the incident, primary will debrief. No blame — it's learning. If you miss repeatedly, we'll ask about schedule fit.

samantha: Coverage note: weekend overnight coverage thinner right now (Sat 02:00-10:00 UTC). If anyone can buddy up as secondary mentor for shadowers, reply here.

lina: I can cover Sat 02:00-10:00 UTC next weekend as secondary. Happy to mentor a shadower.

sam: @alex added you as shadower for Tue slot and sent calendar invite. We label the rota entry as `shadower` so oncall bots treat your ack role as read-only by default.

alex: Thanks! Anything else to review before Tue?

maya: Skim KV-cache eviction causes and routing failovers. We'll walk through a quick simulated alert at 09:15 to practice acknowledging and linking dashboards.

jordan: One more tip: when proposing mitigations, include quick safety checks like `impact_scope`, `rollback_plan`, and `monitoring_window`. Example: `scale +2 | impact_scope=pool-only | rollback=scale -2 | monitor=5m latency 95th`

samantha: We'll do a 5-minute pre-shift rundown at 09:05. Shadower expected to have run local read-only commands and have Slack ready for annotations.

incident-bot: Note: shadower @alex added to rota entry 1760500000 by @sam

oncall-shiftbot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 09:00 UTC — "Oncall shift (primary=samantha, secondary=maya, shadower=alex)"

alex: Appreciate it all. See you Tue 09:00 UTC — excited to learn. :tada:
